curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with why a driving privilege is needed and what the manual covers, then the three tests, the fee and proof rules, the under-eighteen permit rule, and finish with the free vision test and its lens rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per requirement; contrast cards for the free vision test versus fee-based tests and for minor versus adult applicants.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what must be brought and paid before each test and what a vision result means.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what the knowledge test covers and its question count and passing standard, then where it can be taken, who may be in the room, and which aids are allowed or banned.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per office rule; contrast cards for the permitted dictionary versus banned aids and for translators in the test area versus the car.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the passing standard, the allowed aids and what counts as cheating.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Contrast the cheating penalty with an ordinary office retest, then walk through the online test: device, webcam photos, proctor rule and attempt limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for cheating versus ordinary failure, online versus office device, and applicant age versus proctor age.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the waiting periods, ages and attempt limits between rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what the drive test checks, the two waivers and their time windows, then booking, who rides along, preparing the car, and the next-business-day retest.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per drive test rule; contrast cards for the one-year license window versus the two-year course window and for DMV versus a Third Party Tester.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on waiver windows, who may ride along and when a failed drive test can be retaken.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the examiner's equipment check and its consequence, then the always-required items, and finish with the weather-dependent items.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per equipment group; a contrast card for always-required versus weather-dependent equipment.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which equipment problems force a rescheduled drive test.
